## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A combined-reading edition of **Dàoxuān**'s ([道宣](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%81%93%E5%AE%A3)) *Sìfēnlǜ shānbǔ suíjī jiémó shū* 四分律刪補隨機羯磨疏 ([KR6k0019](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0019)) and **Yuánzhào**'s ([元照](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%85%83%E7%85%A7), 1048–1116) *Jìyuán jì* 濟緣記 sub-commentary, integrated by the Japanese Vinaya monk **Zenno** 禪能 ([禪能](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%A6%AA%E8%83%BD)). The catalog meta records the work as 4卷 but the Manji edition prints it in twenty-two distinct sub-fascicles (*juan* shàng/zhōng/xià × seven, plus prefatory matter) reflecting the *gō-e* editorial method, where Dàoxuān's commentary lemmata are interleaved verse-by-verse with Yuánzhào's *jì* gloss.

**Abstract**

The substantive contribution here is **Yuánzhào's *Jìyuán jì*** — the eleventh-century Northern Sòng *jì* on Dàoxuān's [KR6k0019](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0019) *Suíjī jiémó shū* — which together with his *Yèshū jì* (commentary on Dàoxuān's *Jièběn shū*, [KR6k0142](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0142)) and his *Zīchí jì* 資持記 (commentary on the *Xíngshì chāo*) forms the foundational Sòng *Nánshān* sub-commentary corpus. Yuánzhào's *Jìyuán jì* is structurally complementary to Yǔn Kān's earlier *Zhèngyuán jì* ([KR6k0156](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0156)) on the same source; the two sub-commentaries together represent the principal Sòng exegetical tradition on Dàoxuān's karman manual. The *gō-e* recension presented here was produced in Japan and reached the Manji canon through the Tokugawa-era export of *gō-e* Vinaya editions to China. The structural index to Yuánzhào's *jì* is supplied separately as [KR6k0157](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0157).
